newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal reforms family welfare payments.
newsitem.headline: Portugal reforms family welfare payments.

text.p: Portugal's Socialist government on Wednesday approved reforms simplifying the country's family benefits system.
A cabinet statement said that the government had decided to unify various benefits into one single family subsidy which would vary depending on income.
The family welfare payment will have three grades indexed to the national minimum wage of some 57,000 escudos per month.

The highest amount will be paid to families with less than one and a half minimum salaries per month. The next grade runs up to eight times the minimum wage, with the smallest subsidy going to those with more than eight times.
There was no immediate information on the value of the subsidies.
